outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Trump says his super PAC will now pay for controversial taxpayer-funded promo ads; Trump suggests Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego; Jim Bakker, who built ‘PTL Club’ televangelism empire, has died at 86.

items.headline: Trump says his super PAC will now pay for controversial taxpayer-funded promo ads
items.detail: Trump says that he will no longer use taxpayer funds to pay for a pro-Trump ad blitz ahead of the midterm elections, saying his super PAC will now pay for them.

items.headline: Trump suggests Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego
items.detail: President Donald Trump suggested Monday during a political rally in Nebraska that Iran could “take out” Los Angeles and San Diego, comments that drew condemnation.

items.headline: Jim Bakker, who built ‘PTL Club’ televangelism empire, has died at 86
items.detail: Jim Bakker, who along with his first-wife Tammy Faye built an evangelical empire around the hugely successful “The PTL Club” TV show, only to lose it all over a sex scandal and financial crimes, has died

items.headline: WATCH: Finding new homes for rescued beagles
items.detail: ABC News' Danny New takes a closer look at Paws of War, a nonprofit that helps adopt out dogs to active military members, veterans, first responders and more.

items.headline: WATCH: 'Avengers: Endgame' becomes highest-grossing film ever, again
items.detail: Sophie Flay shares the buzziest stories of the day in "GMA" Pop News.
